selection.basis: This is the remaining image-exactness gap whose current remote image already maps to the exact Gravel V3 RS family but may show another market build. A single exact-model listing-image check can determine whether a more faithful remote image is publicly attributable without repeating the previous 50-area campaign.

targets.model: TWITTER Gravel V3 2024 RS / Sensah 2×12 alloy

research_route.action: Run one focused public search for a current or retained exact Gravel V3 2024 RS / Sensah 2×12 alloy seller listing with a directly attributable product image. Open at most one exact item page. Verify visible model/year/build cues, image owner or seller credit, source URL, whether the image can remain a remote embed under the existing rights contract, useful neutral alt text, and fallback behavior.
research_route.stop_rule: At most one web attempt and one exact item page. Do not download or rehost the third-party image, contact sellers, use XHS, log in, bypass a platform control, or reuse an image if the exact model/build or privacy is unclear. If the source does not improve exactness or cannot be safely attributed, add one unresolved attempt and keep the existing image record unchanged.

done_criteria: If an exact attributable public listing image improves the retained photo, add a dated source record and update the existing remote image metadata only: exactness, identity-safe source, seller credit, rights status without asserting a license, descriptive alt text, review date and fallback. Do not store image bytes locally.
Otherwise add one bounded retry attempt with the strongest supported status and preserve the existing remote image and gap.
Run `npm run image:report` once only if the image record changes; run focused validation, coverage acceptance/check, and `npm run check` once for the coherent batch.
Local B78 batch only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or production action.
